capabilities: build configurable kanban boards with columns and due-date rows from vault tasks
triage, filter, color-code and reorder cards with bulk edits and undo
capture tasks from an iPhone via an iOS shortcut into a chosen board
let AI agents and scripts read and modify boards through Obsidian's CLI
keep tasks as Markdown checkboxes and tags in their original notes
extras: MIT-licensed, local-only, no account or telemetry; the AI/CLI feature needs desktop Obsidian 1.13.7 or later with the command line interface setting enabled. Includes starter board templates (Weekly planner, Project, Eisenhower matrix, Example board).
problem: Tasks are scattered across daily notes, meeting notes and project pages, and Obsidian has no board view to plan and reschedule them in one place.

relations.evidence: The optional Tasks plugin adds its task editor and recurring-task behavior.
inspired by the work of Jaroslav Krčál on 4D Eisenhower Matrix

summary: Kanban board plugin that gathers task checkboxes from across the vault into configurable boards with date rows, labels, bulk triage, mobile capture, and a CLI for agents.
